description: Land Aquisition - kaluganga, Laggala D/S Division, Matale District  Sec 38 (1)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land acquisition and divestment matters under the Land Acquisition Act, including specific land allotments, boundaries, and property descriptions. It involves the vesting and divestment of land to/from the State, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters. While a minister is named, this is incidental to the core land transaction content and does not involve government structural changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would trigger a government classification type.
